g.text: S = synchronous call A = asynchronous event / durable job D = data read / write H = explicit human decision
Named browser, web/API, worker and external labels mark process / trust boundaries. IDs resolve in the crosswalk.
Design only. Tool mutation is the sole user-designated stretch; protected rules are outside automatic patches.
